documented_probe: C-b37daad9 (fit a full transformer-inference engine under a strict source-size budget): covered at hard difficulty; the byte cap, mandated compile check, and hidden hyperparameter re-runs are fully enforced by the verifier.
notes: Single-stage: reconstruct a fused-qkv causal pre-LN transformer with SiLU and a vocabulary-projection head from a JSON state dict, under a hard 5000-byte source cap with a mandated py_compile build. Overshooting the cap or failing to compile fails regardless of correctness. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (masked multi-head attention + layernorm math), hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden fixture sets with different dims), quantitative_correctness (exact tokens + 6-decimal logits), and resource_pressure (the byte budget). No tool breadth or dependency chain; totals bucket to hard.
